<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Outlook:</strong> Markets are pricing in a 25 bps repo rate hike—the first since February 2023—as the central bank moves to combat inflation and currency pressure.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I77</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended gains for a second consecutive session, driven by a rally in banking, capital goods, and pharma stocks alongside a decline in Brent crude prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I47</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I67</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I72</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
